@graph.headline: How to Use Notion: Setup Guide
@graph.description: Learn how to use Notion to create pages, databases, wikis and project boards, share content, work offline and move existing data safely, step by step.

itemListElement.name: How to Use Notion: Setup Guide

mainEntity.name: How do I create a database in Notion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Create a new page and choose Table, or type /database in a page. Add properties such as status, owner and due date, then create views with filters and sorts.

mainEntity.name: How do I turn a page into a Notion wiki?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the page menu, choose More and select Turn into wiki. Add an owner and a review routine so readers know who maintains the information.

mainEntity.name: Can I import from another app into Notion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notion supports TXT, Markdown, DOCX, CSV, HTML, PDF and ZIP files, plus direct imports from apps such as Confluence, Asana, Evernote and Trello.

mainEntity.name: How do I export a Notion workspace?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Settings, General and Export all workspace content. Pages can be exported as HTML or Markdown and databases as CSV, with uploaded files. Some restricted pages may be excluded.
